rule: scheduler_derived and manual_writable are independent P6 behavior axes. The current registry computed flag must not collapse these facts.
model_gap: The current P6FieldDefinition invariant rejects writable=True with computed=True, so a field that P6 both scheduler-generates and permits manual update cannot be represented without a future registry-model change.
certification_rule: This gate reports evidence/model relationships only. It never changes registry values or certifies full P6 parity.
